audience: Internal owner and team; shared engine with isolated business configurations
onboardingScope: Marketing-only business inputs. Cash, refunds, manufacturing details and fixed system rules are not required onboarding questions.
priorOnboarding: VOID: owner explicitly discarded all prior answers. None are carried forward.

alphabet.definition: Owner, reviewer, approval boundaries
Explicit objective, horizon and secondary constraints
Available balance, liabilities and settlement lag
Observed orders versus latent stock-censored demand
Stable store, order, line, variant and campaign identities
Capacity, shipment lifecycle and mature cohorts
Definition versions and human review
Source provenance, snapshots, gaps and migrations
Sellable units, history, reserved units and safety stock
Canonical ID crosswalks, cardinality and reconciliation
Numerator, denominator, grain, units and missing-data policy
Production, replenishment, shipping and cash delays
Spend, attribution, creative and campaign-to-SKU mapping
Contribution, variable cost, refunds and fixed costs
Discrete options under explicit objective and constraints
BOM, resource calendars, batches and QC
Completeness, freshness, duplicates and reliability gates
Downside limits, scenario sensitivity and model error
Weekday, promotions, business events and regime changes
Cairo dates, completed days and cohort maturity
Empirical error bands and unverified assumptions
Time-ordered backtests, benchmarks and acceptance thresholds
Funnels at a consistent source and dimension scope
Holdouts, effect estimation and intervention logs
Delivered contribution and manufacturing yield
True zero preserved; blanks unavailable; division by zero unavailable

entities.name: Store
entities.definition: Store owns platform IDs; old/new store are separate namespaces

entities.name: Product
entities.definition: Stable product mapping required; product title is a label

entities.name: Variant
entities.definition: Maps to a reviewed canonical SKU; size aliases require approval

entities.name: InventorySnapshot
entities.definition: Sellable-online snapshot differs from ending inventory

entities.name: InventoryHistory
entities.definition: Wide date columns unpivot to daily units; blank != zero

entities.name: Order
entities.definition: Original created_at preserved across store migrations

entities.name: OrderLine
entities.definition: Quantity and price required; title/price text cannot establish units

entities.name: Customer
entities.definition: PII excluded from decision layer; no automatic person matching

entities.name: Campaign
entities.definition: Name is mutable; map campaigns to promoted SKUs

entities.name: AdSet
entities.definition: Campaign parent must be stable over report date

entities.name: Attribution
entities.definition: Models are alternative allocations, not additive tables

entities.name: SessionAggregate
entities.definition: Do not combine duplicate exports or incompatible scopes

entities.name: Shipment
entities.definition: Status observations need updated_at; not a monetary refund

entities.name: Refund
entities.definition: Processed amount/date/currency not verified in current source

entities.name: ProductionOrder
entities.definition: SKU quantities, resource capacity, BOM, due dates and payments missing

entities.name: CashMovement
entities.definition: Collections and expenditures use settlement dates

entities.name: Decision
entities.definition: Input hash, evidence, options, constraints, human decision and outcome

metrics.definition:
Orders divided by sessions for the same period and scope.

Use placed orders for this conversion metric. Do not substitute delivered orders because the revenue policy is Delivered only. Zero or missing sessions gives an unavailable rate.

Uses totalOrders and sessions

Delivered revenue less advertising spend and the mapped shipping expense.

This excludes any costs not in the formula and must not be labelled net profit. Verify that shipping is a merchant expense, not shipping charges collected from customers; verify refunds and product costs separately.

Uses deliveredRevenue, advertisingSpend, totalShippingCosts

Advertising spend per Meta-attributed purchase event.

Divide total spend by total Meta purchase events for the same period. Meta events are not delivered Shopify orders. Zero denominator is unavailable.

Meta purchase events

Meta purchase events divided by Meta checkout events.

Use totals for the same period and attribution scope. Zero or missing checkouts gives an unavailable rate.

Formula recorded, but existing ad funnel rate still uses built-in calculation

Meta checkout events divided by Meta add-to-cart events.

Ratio of totals for the same period and attribution scope. Zero denominator is unavailable.

Evaluated by website formula engine; safe zero-denominator fallback

Meta add-to-cart events divided by Meta landing-page views.

Ratio of totals for the same period and attribution scope. Zero denominator is unavailable.

Evaluated by website formula engine; safe zero-denominator fallback

Meta landing-page views divided by Meta outbound/link clicks.

Verify the selected click field matches the label. Ratio of totals; zero denominator is unavailable.

Evaluated by website formula engine; safe zero-denominator fallback

Shopify orders matching the existing Meta first-visit attribution rules.

Use attribution.metaSources and attribution.excludedContent. This is a first-visit metric; it does not become linear attribution merely because the Decision Intelligence setting is linear.

Shopify orders matching mapped first-visit source and UTM content in selected date range

Revenue divided by order count within each day.

Numerator and denominator must use exactly the same order eligibility. For a whole period divide total revenue by total qualifying orders, not the average of daily AOVs.

Website daily AOV calculation; not configurable through mapping yet

Mean days to convert over orders with valid conversion durations.

Exclude unavailable durations, not real zero-day conversions. Existing mapping points to Customer Extra Data, which is absent from current workbook metadata.

Website currently computes directly from Customer Extra Data

Mean Shopify journey moments used as a sessions-to-conversion proxy.

Keep the proxy label. Exclude unavailable counts, not genuine zeros. Existing mapping points to the absent Customer Extra Data tab.

Website currently computes directly from Customer Extra Data

Daily value relative to the selected-period average.

Existing thresholds: above 1.10, between 0.90 and 1.10, below 0.90. Cost metrics reverse the good/bad direction. This is a display rule, not a business KPI.

Green above 1.10, orange 0.90–1.10, red below 0.90; reversed for cost metrics

Qualifying first-visit Meta orders whose mapped delivery status is Delivered.

Use the same attribution rules as metrics.metaAdsOrders and the mapped delivered status. The mapped date is the order date, not necessarily the delivery date.

Qualifying Shopify orders with the mapped delivery status

Meta advertising spend per qualifying Shopify Meta order.

Divide period spend by qualifying orders for that same period. Do not average daily CPAs; zero denominator is unavailable.

Meta spend and Shopify orders for the same date range

Meta advertising spend per delivered qualifying Shopify Meta order.

Use the same attribution and date rules as deliveredMetaAdsOrders. Not the same as Meta purchase-event CPA. Zero denominator is unavailable.

Meta spend and delivered Shopify orders for the same date range
Order creation cohort; original store-aware identity required; cancellation policy explicit

metrics.formula: count(orders with verified final delivered status)
metrics.definition: Order creation date cohort differs from delivery-date revenue

metrics.formula: sum(order K for delivered eligible orders)
metrics.definition: Observed order amount; tax, shipping and refunds treatment unverified

metrics.formula: delivered merchandise amount - monetary refunds under approved date basis
metrics.definition: Missing refund source makes net revenue unavailable

metrics.formula: sum(eligible placed amounts) / count(eligible placed orders)
metrics.definition: Same numerator and denominator eligibility; do not substitute delivered revenue

metrics.formula: sum(delivered eligible amounts) / count(delivered eligible orders)
metrics.definition: Use ratio of totals, not average daily AOV

metrics.formula: delivered / (delivered + returned) within mature creation cohort
metrics.definition: Pending shipments excluded from resolved denominator; cohort maturity must be approved
Revenue collected from customer; not the carrier expense

metrics.formula: sum(actual carrier invoices under approved allocation)
metrics.definition: Not mapped in the audited order source
A returned shipment does not establish a refund

metrics.formula: netDeliveredRevenue - product COGS - variable fulfillment - failed delivery costs
metrics.definition: Cost and refund source coverage required; fixed costs excluded
Not net profit unless fixed costs and all remaining costs are included

metrics.formula: contributionAfterAds - approved fixed and other operating expenses
metrics.definition: Unavailable until cost boundaries and time basis are verified
Platform window/scope fixed; not causal incremental return

metrics.formula: incremental contribution from tested intervention / incremental spend
metrics.definition: Needs experimental or defensibly identified incremental effect

metrics.formula: latest verified online-sellable quantity by store and variant
metrics.definition: Blank unavailable; zero valid; do not add migrated store snapshots
Different measurement from current sellable stock

metrics.formula: sum(verified line-item quantities by canonical SKU and original order date)
metrics.definition: Source 7/28 day counters remain unverified; not inferred from stock deltas

metrics.formula: usableStock / uncensored expected daily unit demand
metrics.definition: Zero demand gives unavailable coverage; inbound timing handled separately

metrics.formula: opening + approved receipts + inspected returns - demand - adjustments
metrics.definition: Variant and date reconciliation required; manufacturing lead time applies

metrics.formula: max(0, demand over lead time + safety stock - usable stock - approved inbound)
metrics.definition: Compare daily stock path; an end-period total alone can hide earlier stockout

metrics.formula: opening cash + settled receipts - actual timed cash out
metrics.definition: Sales and deliveries do not equal collections

metrics.formula: sum(batch quantity * approved resource usage per unit)
metrics.definition: Integer MOQ, batch multiples, calendar and BOM required
No shuffled train/test split; maturity and gap exclusions enforced
Zero actual denominator unavailable; report MAE alongside
Descriptive comparison; price/stock/channel changes confound causal interpretation
Different from attributed order count divided by sessions; one model view only
Derived from reported CPM; not raw verified impressions; CTR uses consistent click basis

questions.question: إيه أهم نتيجة تسويقية عايز تحسّنها؟
questions.example: توزيع ميزانية الإعلانات، أو كمية الإنتاج، أو ترتيب مشاكل الموقع
questions.why: نبدأ بقرار محدد نقدر نقيس نتيجته.

questions.question: نقارن نتيجة القرار على مدة قد إيه؟
questions.why: بيع الستوك بسرعة ممكن يختلف عن أفضل نتيجة للشهر.

questions.question: أقصى صرف إعلاني مسموح يوميًا وخلال مدة الخطة؟
مسموح نغيّر ميزانية الحملة قد إيه وفي مدة قد إيه؟
questions.example: بحد أقصى 15% في اليوم، ومراجعة بعد 3 أيام
questions.why: نولّد بدائل ضمن نطاق مسموح بدل زيادات غير محدودة.

questions.question: نحافظ على حد أدنى من القطع الجاهزة لكل SKU؟
questions.example: 5 قطع لمقاس M، أو تغطية 7 أيام لمنتجات محددة
questions.why: قيد توافر واضح يحدد هل نكمل حملة قبل نفاد الستوك.

questions.question: في حملات لازم تفضل شغالة أو ممنوع نصرف عليها؟
questions.answer: بدون حد أدنى؛ حد أقصى حسب ميزانية اليوم
questions.example: حملة A حد أدنى 300؛ حملة B حد أقصى 1,000

questions.question: عايز تنسب البيع للإعلانات بإيه في المقارنة؟
questions.example: First click أو Last click أو Linear؛ ونحتفظ بقياس Meta منفصل
questions.why: المصدر فيه 5 نماذج. مينفعش نجمعها أو نخلطها بقياس Meta.

questions.question: تكلفة الاسترجاع الكاملة اللي بتتحملها للطلب المرتجع كام؟
questions.example: رقم بالجنيه لكل طلب مرتجع؛ يشمل شحن الرجوع وأي تكلفة إضافية. اتركه فاضي لو مش معروف.
questions.why: نحسب تكلفة الرجوع منفصلة عن المنتج والتوصيل؛ لا تُفترض صفرًا.

questions.question: التكلفة المتغيرة الكاملة للقطعة كام؟
questions.example: رقم بالجنيه لو موحد لكل المنتجات، أو رابط جدول لكل SKU. وضّح لو شامل الشحن أو الإعلان أو الاسترجاع.
questions.why: نستخدم تكلفة كل SKU ونمنع تكرار تحميل نفس البند؛ غياب التكلفة يمنع الربح فقط.

questions.question: إجمالي التكاليف الثابتة الشهرية بالكامل — غير الإنفاق الإعلاني فقط — كام؟
questions.example: جنيه/شهر: يشمل أي رواتب واشتراكات تسويق ثابتة؛ يستبعد الإنفاق الإعلاني فقط.
questions.why: نفصل هامش المساهمة عن النتيجة بعد التكاليف الثابتة. لو فاضي النتيجة غير متاحة.
